Xenophobia is an irrational fear of people from other countries and/or cultures. It can be directed toward any nationality but most often it’s aimed at immigrants who come into your country with different beliefs than you do; this includes both legal migrants as well illegal ones (like refugees). The term also applies when someone has negative feelings towards foreigners living nearby them – even if there isn’t anything actually wrong about these individuals themselves!
